_comment: Hand-curated registry overrides/additions, merged ONTO the auto-built tickers.json by ticker_registry._registry_index (so they survive a rebuild). Each entry is a PARTIAL record — only the fields being set/fixed. Use for (a) fixing a misclassification, or (b) adding a peer/slug ticker that the auto-build's name-pattern classifier couldn't identify (e.g. UAE bank rows that arrived with no company name → defaulted to sector 'other').

ENBD.AE.notes: registry_overrides: UAE bank; name-less source row defaulted to 'other'.

FAB.AE.notes: registry_overrides: UAE bank; name-less source row defaulted to 'other'.

ADCB.AE.notes: registry_overrides: UAE bank; name-less source row defaulted to 'other'.

DIB.AE.notes: registry_overrides: UAE bank; name-less source row defaulted to 'other'.

9988.HK.notes: registry_overrides: Alibaba reports in RMB (CNY) and its fiscal year ENDS 31 March (registry default Dec/HKD was wrong, breaking grounding-currency staleness checks).

0981.HK.notes: registry_overrides: SMIC reports its financials in USD (registry defaulted to HKD).
